duty_text: Duty of parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to child aged 6 to 14 years.
rationale: Direct constitutional complement: The State guarantees Right to Education under 21A, while parents/guardians carry the corresponding duty under 51A(k).

duty_text: Duty to protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers and wildlife, and to have compassion for living creatures.
rationale: Right to Life under Article 21 encompasses clean environment (Subhash Kumar v. State of Bihar), matched by civic duty 51A(g) to preserve nature.

duty_text: Duty to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all people of India transcending religious, linguistic and regional diversities.
rationale: Freedom of speech and expression under Article 19(1)(a) must be exercised responsibly without inciting communal discord or hatred.

duty_text: Duty to renounce practices derogatory to the dignity of women.
rationale: Equality before law and prohibition of discrimination (Articles 14 & 15) requires active societal commitment to dignity of women.

duty_text: Duty to abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem.
rationale: The constitutional remedy framework under Article 32 requires respect for constitutional institutions and constitutionalism.

duty_text: Duty to develop scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
rationale: Freedom of conscience and religion under Article 25 is balanced by duty to foster rational, scientific inquiry and reform.
